scope: targeted Mini App client/security/component review, not general production audit

review.hooks: top-level, stable boot callback, cleanup SDK/BackButton/fetch/timer/beforeunload/document attributes
review.accessibility: labels/legends, aria status/alerts/current navigation, keyboard CityPicker, focus styles, decorative icons hidden
review.privacy: no Clerk/Analytics mount on Mini App, own-profile DTO, no raw session/initData browser storage or logs
review.sharedRules: presentation components use dictionaries; writes use existing validation/policy/cities/children/history
review.rendering: local font and existing sized SVG, scoped branded light CSS, responsive logical spacing
